## Release status

::: {.sarna-placeholder}
**No database release is available yet.**

The first validated database release will accompany the associated review article after the database has been finalized and validated. This page intentionally contains no records from working materials.
:::

## Planned search and table

The future interface will provide a searchable, sortable, and filterable view of a wide table. It is planned as a static client-side table with:

- one global search box;
- sortable columns;
- filtering and clear result navigation;
- pagination for longer result sets; and
- horizontal scrolling for wide tables;

No synthetic scientific records will be used in the placeholder site.

## Planned record content

The future release is expected to organize the following types of information:

- saRNA sequences and duplex details;
- target, gene, species, and genomic context;
- experimental conditions and delivery details;
- reported outcomes and their readout context; and
- source provenance and later corrections.

These are planned categories, not a finalized schema or released records. Final field names, inclusion rules, and identifier policies will be approved before publication.

## Future release information

Future releases will provide downloads of the authoritative Excel workbook and its CSV export. Each release will identify its version, data dictionary, changelog, and Zenodo version record. The finalized Excel workbook will be the authoritative source for each release.
